_readme: Add custom events to the 'events' array. They are merged with anniversaries from timeline_banners_output.json. Events already present by name are ignored.

_template.name: Name shown in the pack table header (required)
_template.jp_start: JP release date YYYY-MM-DD — global date is estimated automatically
_template.start: Override: exact global date YYYY-MM-DD (takes priority over jp_start)
_template.packs: Optional — list of pack keys to show. Omit to use automatic logic. Use [] to show none.
_template.pack_limits: Optional — max quantity per pack key e.g. {"p7500": 3, "p1500": 2}. Omit to use automatic logic.
_template.selectors: Optional — list of selector keys to show. Omit to use automatic logic. Use [] to show none.
_template.step_up_banner: Optional — banner_name of a step_up entry in custom_banners.json. Name and start date are copied automatically by sync.
_template.selector_counts: step_up only — max quantity per selector key e.g. {"s21uma": 3, "s21ssr": 2}. Renders quantity dropdowns instead of checkboxes.
_template.selector_labels: Optional — override display labels per selector key e.g. {"s21uma": "★3", "s21ssr": "SSR"}.

_step_up_template._note: Step-up events: name and start are synced automatically from the linked custom_banners step_up entry. Only add selectors/packs that apply.
_step_up_template.name: Copied from the step_up banner_name — set manually if not using sync
_step_up_template.step_up_banner: Must match banner_name of the step_up entry in custom_banners.json exactly
_step_up_template.start: Copied from the step_up start_date — set manually if not using sync
